channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Grafana Applies SLOs and Error Budgets to AI Agent Behaviour
item.description: Grafana Labs is proposing a familiar reliability engineering approach for one of the less familiar problems in modern software: how to measure whether an AI agent is actually behaving well. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending? Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp
item.description: You submit a Kubernetes Job and wait for its Pods to appear. A minute passes. Then another. The Job is still suspended, there are no application logs, and there may not even be a Pod to inspect. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Go Was Burning 60% CPU Just Running GC. The Fix Was a Memory Limit.
item.description: A Go service can burn CPU collecting garbage without having a memory leak. That is the counterintuitive part of Zomato's Go garbage collection story. (1 source: rprogramming)
